notes: The county site grimescountytexas.gov (and www.) and its GovOffice host grimescountytx.govoffice.com publish a robots.txt with 'User-agent: * Disallow: /' (only named crawlers allowed), so the fetch module refused every request; www.co.grimes.tx.us was unreachable. This was accepted, not bypassed. No Clarity site (elections.json 404). One web search located result PDFs on grimescountytx.govoffice.com (titles such as 'Cumulative Results Report ... Run Time 7:05 PM 05/26/2026' and 'Cumulative_Results-3-3-2026_11-27-06_PM.pdf'), but search text is not evidence and the files could not be fetched. Check 3 pending for all three elections (origin/wayback-data not present). Targeted pass 3 2026-10-02 (targeted3-J): No change. Wayback harvest (wayback_snapshots/Grimes) has no captures (2024 and primary CDX queries failed, runoff query empty); no targeted archives, targeted wayback or sweep file. County hosts still robots-disallowed (not bypassed). One web search found KWHI 'ELECTION RESULTS - AREA COUNTIES' (kwhi.com/2026/03/03/election-results-area-counties-2/, published 2026-03-03T18:45-06:00, modified 2026-03-05) with Grimes County race totals only (e.g. 'Barbara Kimich (R, i) - 2,132'), no per-precinct numbers, so it fails check 4. Navasota Examiner hits returned 404.
